AI 100.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
AI 100.description: Core methodological paradigms in AI. Strengths and limitations of modern AI systems. Social impacts of AI technologies: economic, cultural, scientific, environmental, political. Philosophical implications and plausible future trajectories for AI.

AI 240.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
AI 240.description: Core methodological paradigms in machine learning. Models for supervised prediction and unsupervised analysis. Deep learning techniques using differentiable programming.
AI 240.prerequisiteText: Both (a) one of CPSC_V 107, CPSC_V 110 and (b) one of MATH_V 111, MATH_V 131, MATH_V 152, MATH_V 221, MATH_V 223, MATH_O 221, MATH_O 222

AI 322.title: Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
AI 322.description: Introduction to representation and reasoning via topics such as Search, problem-solving and planning, logic, probabilistic graphical models, preference models, Markov decision processes and reinforcement learning, as well as multi-agent decision making
AI 322.prerequisiteText: Either CPSC_V 340 or all of (a) one of AI_V 240, CPSC_V 330 and (b) one of CPSC_V 221, DSCI_V 221 and (c) one of STAT_V 251, ECON_V 325, ECON_V 327, MATH_V 302, STAT_V 302, MATH_V 318

AI 360.title: Deep Learning
AI 360.description: Advanced machine learning focused on deep learning in practice: mathematical foundations, models for unstructured, sequential, spatial, and graph data, methods for prediction, generative modeling, and reinforcement learning, and hands-on experience designing, optimizing, tuning, and applying deep models.
AI 360.prerequisiteText: Either CPSC_V 340 or all of (a) one of AI_V 240, CPEN_V 355 and (b) MATH_V 200 and (c) one of STAT_V 251, ECON_V 325, ECON_V 327, MATH_V 302, STAT_V 302, MATH_V 318

AI 422.title: Intelligent Systems
AI 422.description: Principles and techniques underlying the design, implementation and evaluation of intelligent computational systems. Applications of artificial intelligence to natural language understanding, image understanding and computer-based expert and advisor systems. Advanced symbolic programming methodology.
